messages:
maria (support): Hey team — customer 'gym-app' (acct: acct_9a3b) hitting persistent 429s during live demo. They say it started ~2026-03-15T10:02:00Z and is blocking sign-ups.

maria (support): Repro attached: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-demo-..." -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","input":"hello"}' | jq .
Response: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"Token quota exceeded for plan: free-tier","code":429}
Headers: X-RateLimit-Limit: 60/min, X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0, X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d

alex (eng): thx. can you paste the full request id + sample headers from the failing client? Is this coming from a single IP or many? also which endpoint exactly (chat vs generate)?

maria (support): request id req_0a1b2c3d, client IP 18.205.23.4 and same key used from their web demo. Endpoint /v1/generate. They claim traffic is bursty during onboarding flow — 200 concurrent users for 5–10 minutes.

ops-bot: Automatic alert: quota_exhaustion detected for acct_9a3b at 2026-03-15T10:02:05Z — rule: free-tier-per-minute. Suggested mitigation: temporary_burst_flag candidate.

sahil (sre): Looks like free-tier hard cap. Two options: 1) immediate short-lived quota bump (ops-only) for 6–24h to unblock demo; 2) sales-assisted upgrade to paid plan. For quick unblock I can apply a 10x burst for 4 hours if we have approval. Need owner + risk signoff.

julie (support-manager): Approve provisional 4-hour temp bump to 10x for acct_9a3b to preserve demo. Please log the change and set auto-revert. Also add note with customer contact info. Who will own the handoff to sales?

sales-sara (sales): I'll pick this up. I'll reach out to the customer during the demo and propose the Starter monthly plan. If they convert we can make the bump permanent. Contact: amy@gymapp.io. Please CC me on the temp bump.

alex (eng): For mitigation, suggest client-side rate limit strategy too: exponential backoff + per-user token bucket. Example header parsing:

```
// pseudo
const remaining = parseInt(resp.headers['x-ratelimit-remaining'] || '0')
if (remaining <= 0) await sleep( backoffWithJitter() )
```

Also we can route their production key to dedicated lower-latency tier if they sign.

maria (support): done — ops applied temporary_burst: multiplier=10 duration=4h, started 2026-03-15T10:05:12Z, auto-revert scheduled 2026-03-15T14:05:12Z. Logged under ops-change-789. Customer confirm: demo resumed, no more 429s.

sahil (sre): added monitoring alert to watch token spend and latency. If we see sustained >50% of dedicated capacity we will throttle and notify sales+eng.

sales-sara (sales): I've scheduled a call with Amy at 10:30 PT to discuss Starter upgrade. Will update here with outcome.

maria (support): closing as 'temporary-burst-applied' — will reopen if 429s return after auto-revert. Docs note: internal playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/temp-burst

julie (support-manager): nice. postmortem if we need to extend bump or if they exploit repeated bursts. cc @sahil @alex

alex (eng): follow-up action: create a small runbook snippet for support to check X-RateLimit-* headers and run the repro curl above. I'll draft and drop it in #devex.

ops-bot: Change logged: ops-change-789 by sahil at 2026-03-15T10:06:02Z — temp_burst multiplier=10 duration=4h auto-revert=2026-03-15T14:05:12Z

maria (support): thanks everyone — customer confirmed demo success. Closing thread.
